source_record.english: One may raise another question: "Suppose a group of people are engaged in a war or similar activity, and one of these people kills someone from the other side. Does a path of action occur only for the one person who actually did the killing?" It does not. Because they are engaged in the war (or whatever activity it may be) for the same common goal, all the people involved come to possess a full path of action, just as much as the one who commits it.
